throughput_version: UVIS1 total-system throughput at reference epoch 2009-06-26; photometric calibration of October 2020 (Calamida et al. 2021, WFC3 ISR 2021-04)
sensitivity_version: WFC3 Instrument Handbook (Cycle 34), Table 6.10; on-orbit sensitivity from SMOV4
sensitivity_assumptions: Unresolved point source with optimal (PSF-weighted) extraction
Published values are limiting AB magnitudes at S/N = 10 in 1 hour (10-hour limits are stored for validation)
Published magnitudes are rounded to 0.1 mag (about 10% in flux)
Throughput curves are for UVIS chip 1, which matches the handbook pivot wavelengths; UVIS2 is up to ~30% more sensitive below ~2500 Angstrom
Only filters with a published limiting magnitude are available as observing filters
